scope: Partial static source census only; no implemented/admitted writer REV

policy.scope: 3.5.3.1: ordinary per-VM global-value writes, from Scheme SET_GLO and reflective GLOBALVARSET to the canonical cell scanned by ROOT_GLOBALS. This is a source-audited proposed responsibility cut, not an implemented or admitted runtime REV. Shared PRMCELL writers, all FFI and whole ROOTS remain separate.
policy.contract: A real write either commits to the canonical VM cell before its source freezes, with a happens-before path to scanning, or is refused/deferred without a store or lost source root. A count snapshot alone is not writer exclusion. Do not add per-store locking or reuse an RC ownership name as proof of a new complete root-write protocol.
policy.qnt: dev/refactoring/modern-c/models/quint/root_store_projection.qnt: beginWriter/finishWriter, closeAdmission/freeze and canonical aliases; existing competing histories only, unchanged. Its closedWriters premise is not established by the present C macros.
policy.lean: dev/refactoring/modern-c/models/lean/RuntimeOwnership.lean: instantiate root-slot coverage/relocation laws only after a real cell map is proved. No duplicated schedule or C weak-memory theorem; unchanged and not rerun.
policy.firstPatch: Preserve SET_GLO/GLOBALVARSET spelling and evaluation semantics; route generated and reflective ordinary stores to one source-authorized capability. Include actual runtime binding/ABI consumers and old-module rejection if the required service changes the interface. Account for setup before publication and declared raw C writers. Do not include the shared primitive-cell protocol or W!=R redesign in this cut.
policy.benefit: Conditional: replace implicit stopped-carrier/root-count assumptions by explicit canonical-cell ownership and close/store arbitration; enable independent root tasks without racing late writes. No measured throughput or GC improvement follows from this source audit.
policy.cost: Unresolved choice: per-store synchronization versus an activation-scoped permit. Must count actual acquisitions, metadata and critical-path operations for the chosen implementation; neither is claimed free or implemented. Additional remembered-set costs belong to their separate future contract.

generated.responsibility: Two real emitter sites; preserve one evaluation and global binding selection.

reflective.responsibility: Actual global-var-set! lowering, distinct from primitive-set!.

ordinary.responsibility: Direct lvalue store today; lacks explicit writer admission.

macro.responsibility: Direct generated lvalue store today; aliases reflective ordinary cell.

coordinates.responsibility: VM glos[index] versus SINGLE_VM direct cell; compile modes must remain distinct.

shared.responsibility: Shared PRMCELL store; cannot infer per-VM ownership from the ordinary global mapping.

freeze.responsibility: Existing closed-roster/RC-frozen premise and one common count; does not supply missing store permits.

scan.responsibility: Actual canonical source slice consumed by one claimed scan task.

census.condition: Enumerate generated/reflection/setup/raw C ordinary stores and distinguish compiler-controlled from unadmitted external lvalue aliases.

arbitration.condition: Real C permission issue/last store/release/close path, memory order and failure custody; no gate held across collecting work or callbacks.

identity.condition: Prove both ordinary forms map to the actual scanned cell in each admitted compile mode; shared primitive storage stays a distinct owner.

moduleBinding.condition: Actual header/generator/runtime/module table mapping and old-module behavior if changed; keep Gerbil build names and public Scheme names.

native.condition: Real generated and reflective assignment, processor0/nonzero, close/store race, relocation and failure effects with implementation PBT/replay/shrink and unchanged official consumers.

stores.condition: Actual ordinary writes through both source forms and actual canonical cell; processor0/nonzero.

racing.condition: Real close/store ordering, moving GC and refusal/failure non-effects; no heap/wait increase.

replay.condition: Actual implementation histories, independent predecessor control, exported replay and shrinking.

consumers.condition: Same production/Bazel profile and official populations; source-disjoint baseline attribution is separate from whole SMP acceptance.
